items.source: This class supports the use of prepared statements when enabling setUsePreparedStatements(boolean). All statements created by methods of this class (such as select(Query, Class) or update(Query, org.springframework.data.cassandra.core.query.Update, Class) will be executed as prepared statements. Also, statements accepted by methods (such as select(String, Class) or and others) will be prepared prior to execution. Note that Statement objects passed to methods must be SimpleStatement so that these can be prepared.
items.translation: 该类在启用setUsePreparedStatements(boolean)时支持使用预编译语句。通过此类的各种方法（例如 select(Query, Class) 或 update(Query, org.springframework.data.cassandra.core.query.Update, Class)）创建的所有语句都将作为预编译语句执行。此外，由方法接受的语句（例如 select(String, Class) 或 以及其他）在执行前也会被预编译。请注意，传递给方法的Statement对象必须是SimpleStatement类型，以便能够对其进行预编译。

items.source: Can be used within a service implementation via direct instantiation with a CqlSession reference, or get prepared in an application context and given to services as bean reference.
items.translation: 可在服务实现中通过直接使用 `CqlSession` 引用进行实例化，或在应用上下文中预先准备并以 Bean 引用形式提供给服务。

items.source: Note: The CqlSession should always be configured as a bean in the application context, in the first case given to the service directly, in the second case to the prepared template.
items.translation: 注意：CqlSession 应始终在应用程序上下文中配置为 Bean，第一种情况是直接提供给服务，第二种情况是提供给预编译模板。

items.source: Returns whether this instance is configured to use prepared statements. If enabled (default), then all persistence methods (such as select(String, Class), update(Query, Update, Class), and others) will make use of prepared statements. Note that methods accepting a Statement must be called with SimpleStatement instances to participate in statement preparation.
items.translation: 返回此实例是否配置为使用预编译语句。如果启用（默认），则所有持久化方法（例如select(String, Class)、update(Query, Update, Class)等）都将使用预编译语句。请注意，接受Statement参数的方法必须传入SimpleStatement实例才能参与语句准备。

items.source: Enable/disable prepared statements usage. If enabled (default), then all persistence methods (such as select(String, Class), update(Query, Update, Class), and others) will make use of prepared statements. Note that methods accepting a Statement must be called with SimpleStatement instances to participate in statement preparation.
items.translation: 启用/禁用 `prepared statements` 的使用。如果启用（默认），则所有持久化方法（例如 `select(String, Class)`、`update(Query, Update, Class)` 等）都将使用预编译语句。请注意，接受 `Statement` 参数的方法必须传入 `SimpleStatement` 实例才能参与语句准备。

items.source: Primary implementation of AsyncCassandraOperations. It simplifies the use of asynchronous Cassandra usage and helps to avoid common errors. It executes core Cassandra workflow. This class executes CQL queries or updates, initiating iteration over ResultSet and catching Cassandra exceptions and translating them to the generic, more informative exception hierarchy defined in the org.springframework.dao package.
items.translation: 这是 `AsyncCassandraOperations` 接口的主要实现。它简化了异步 Cassandra 的使用，并有助于避免常见错误。该类执行核心的 Cassandra 工作流：运行 CQL 查询或更新操作，启动对 `ResultSet` 的迭代，捕获 Cassandra 异常并将其转换为定义在 `org.springframework.dao` 包中的通用且信息更丰富的异常层次结构中的异常。
